dossier.headline: Cupid's Q2 profit more than doubles; guidance raised
dossier.summary: Cupid reported a 133% rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to ₹56.22 crore and raised its FY27 revenue guidance to at least ₹880 crore. The shares hit a 52-week high on November 12, rising as much as 9.88% to ₹389.
